description: Random anonymised research identifier; cannot be mapped back to any member.
calculation: Fisher-Yates shuffle of eligible rows using crypto random bytes; no mapping persisted.

description: Date of the member's first verified AI-assisted introduction (email send).
calculation: minimum sent_at of delivery rows for the member's sent AI groups.

description: Calendar month of the index introduction.
calculation: first 7 characters of index_ai_intro_date.

description: Days between the member's join date and the index introduction.
missing_value_meaning: NULL = join date missing or negative tenure anomaly (flagged, set NULL).
calculation: floor((index_ai_intro_date - Date joined)/86400000).

description: Number of sent AI-assisted introduction groups the member appears in.
calculation: count of distinct sent groups containing the member.

description: AI introductions received within 30 days of index.
calculation: count of member's sent groups with sent_at < index + 30 days.

description: AI introductions received within 60 days of index.
calculation: count of member's sent groups with sent_at < index + 60 days.

description: AI introductions received within 90 days of index.
calculation: count of member's sent groups with sent_at < index + 90 days.

description: Number of distinct other members the member was introduced to via AI matching.
calculation: count of distinct other member record ids in the member's sent groups.

description: Number of distinct AI matching cycle identifiers (per city cycle) the member participated in.
calculation: count of distinct cycle ids across the member's sent groups (one per city in a monthly cycle).

description: Whether the AI introduction was the member's first ever community introduction.
allowed_values: 0 = first introduction; 1 = recurring (had >=1 legacy introduction before index)
calculation: 1 if member appears in any legacy Airtable MATCH GROUPS row dated before the index date; else 0.

description: Average size of the AI introduction groups the member was placed in.
calculation: mean member count of the member's sent groups.

description: Number of distinct partners the member was introduced to more than once (legacy + AI history up to analysis date).
calculation: per partner: legacy occurrences + AI occurrences; count partners with occurrences >= 2.

description: Proportion of all distinct partners who were a repeat match.
missing_value_meaning: NULL = member has no recorded partners at all
calculation: repeat_match_count / total distinct partners.

description: Mean stored pair score (0-1 weighted combination) for the member's co-introduced pairs.
missing_value_meaning: NULL = no pair scores recorded for the member's groups
calculation: mean of overall scores for pair-score rows whose both member keys belong to the member's sent group.

description: Median stored pair score for the member's co-introduced pairs.
calculation: median of the same pair scores.

description: Minimum stored pair score for the member's co-introduced pairs.
calculation: min of the same pair scores.

description: Maximum stored pair score for the member's co-introduced pairs.
calculation: max of the same pair scores.

description: Mean AI (Pinecone semantic similarity) score component for the member's co-introduced pairs. Stored historical value at matching time.
missing_value_meaning: NULL = component absent in stored scores
calculation: mean of ai_correlation components for the same pair-score rows.

description: Classification of the system that generated the member's AI introduction.
calculation: All qualifying introductions come from the unified AI-assisted email engine (production runs).

description: Version of the matching profile (weights/constraints) used for the member's run.
calculation: profile version integer of the run that produced the member's group.

description: Number of eligible members in the member's city matching pool during the index cycle.
calculation: length of the frozen eligible-member list in the member's city run snapshot.

description: Privacy-safe quartile category of the member's city matching-pool size.
calculation: quartiles of the per-city pool-size distribution (thresholds documented in quality report).

description: Number of AI introduction emails handed to the email provider for the member (provider confirmed delivery events are not stored).
calculation: count of the member's delivery rows with status 'sent'.

description: Share of the member's delivery rows recorded as sent without failure.
calculation: sent delivery rows / total delivery rows for the member (all rows currently 'sent').

description: Member had valid WLTH WLKS service access 30 days after the index introduction.
missing_value_meaning: NULL = insufficient elapsed observation time (index + 30 days is after the analysis date)
calculation: evaluateServiceAccess(policy v2, billing pause blocks) at index + 30 days.

description: Member had valid service access 60 days after the index introduction.
calculation: evaluateServiceAccess at index + 60 days.

description: Member had valid service access 90 days after the index introduction.
calculation: evaluateServiceAccess at index + 90 days.

description: Member had valid service access 120 days after the index introduction.
calculation: evaluateServiceAccess at index + 120 days.

description: Member had valid service access 180 days after the index introduction.
calculation: evaluateServiceAccess at index + 180 days.

description: Days from the index introduction until the member's stored service-access end date (for members whose access has now ended).
missing_value_meaning: NULL = access end date missing, or access still valid at analysis date (right-censored)
calculation: floor((Service access until - index)/day) when the stored end date is in the past; NULL otherwise.

description: Whether the member had valid service access on the analysis date (interim outcome; not a standard retention window).
calculation: evaluateServiceAccess(policy v2) at analysis date.

description: Number of legacy (pre-AI) introductions the member received before the index date.
calculation: count of legacy match-group participations dated before index.
